trust_decision.summary: Whether a stored user-controlled name (media-manager type name, effect short name, article/category/media/language name, diff filename, PHPMailer string) is text or markup when it is concatenated into backend HTML: decided at each output site by escaping the stored value alone with rex_escape() (htmlspecialchars, ENT_QUOTES), never at storage or by escaping the surrounding HTML fragment.

landing_point.why: The advisory names mediaIsInUse() and the media-manager type name; the LEFT JOIN at media_manager.php:450-454 selects type.name and line 457 concatenates it raw into the 'media is in use' warning link that mediapool/lib/mediapool.php:98 returns to the backend delete error.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report and the advisory title name the media-manager type name, while rex_metainfo_media_handler::isMediaInUse() is an optional, separately installable addon's own MEDIA_IS_IN_USE subscriber that lists article, category, media and language names - a different feature and payload, so it can be argued to be outside the reported flaw.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The in-use warning is intentionally an HTML fragment: each entry is an <a href="javascript:openPage(...)"> link and the fragments are concatenated and printed raw, so escaping the whole message, or returning pre-escaped HTML from the extension point, breaks the jump-to-type / jump-to-article links and double-escapes names containing & or quotes.

O6_input_shapes:
plain stored string as element text: 'name' / '
  • name
    • ' (metainfo handler lines 65, 79, 93, 106; mediapool.php:87)
stored string inside a quoted HTML attribute: '<input type="checkbox" ... value="$file" />' (sync.php:120)
label text inside a list element: '<label>' . $file . '</label>' (sync.php:119)
value obtained from an object getter rather than a raw SQL row: rex_article::getName() (mediapool.php:86)
value rendered through a non-escaping i18n path: the custom rex_list formatter return value (effects.php:88) and names fed to rex_i18n::rawMsg (effects.php:115,127,129)
non-database string from a third-party library: PHPMailer Debugoutput callback argument and $mail->ErrorInfo (checkmail.php:38,43)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second custom rex_list formatter (or an added column) returning the stored media_manager_type_effect.effect or parameters value raw
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: custom formatters opt out of rex_list's automatic escaping (redaxo/src/core/lib/list.php:1133), so any new custom column echoing a stored value reopens exactly this sink; the file already uses this idiom

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a fifth in-use list (e.g. for media categories or templates) built like the four existing ones
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic:
the handler already holds four near-identical '
  • name
    • ' lists; a maintainer adding another metainfo prefix copies one and can forget rex_escape

O8b_injection_room.sibling: one more entity type appended to the same warning before the extension point fires
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the function already accumulates article warnings and then merges addon warnings; a new line would follow the same raw concatenation

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a third rendering of the same diff-file name (e.g. a link opening the file) inside the $writable element array
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the fixed hunk already renders the same value twice in one array element, so adding a third concatenation is a natural copy

O9_family: CWE-79 stored cross-site scripting (missing HTML output encoding of stored user-controlled names in backend pages)

O10_build.toolchain: composer (vendor libs committed under redaxo/src/{core,addons/*}/vendor), PHPUnit via composer script 'phpunit' and phpunit.dist.xml, phpstan/psalm for static analysis
services: PHP web server for the backend pages
O10_build.project_tests: PHPUnit suites under redaxo/src/core/tests and the addons' tests/ dirs (media_manager/tests/media_manager_test.php covers cache filenames, media file names and URLs; mediapool/tests covers media/filename helpers); no test at the pinned commit covers mediaIsInUse(), the in-use warning HTML or output escaping, and the fix adds none

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap the whole warning/alert string (or the media-manager type name at save time in types.php) in rex_escape: it double-escapes legitimate names containing & or quotes and kills the javascript:openPage() anchor markup, while leaving the other addons' raw output untouched.
